source.name: New England Patriots (patriots.com) – P&G extends naming rights for Gillette Stadium through the 2031 season
source.quote: includes exclusive naming and sponsorship rights of Gillette Stadium through the 2031 football season.

note: Arena naming rights: Gillette Stadium, named since August 2002; this 2010-09-22 release extended the naming and sponsorship rights through the 2031 season.
